notes_for_editor: Brief record matches the sources on county, ground kind, status and coordinates; no correction proposed. Only one lookout-specific page (firelookout.com) gives a date and design, so the 1937 build is single-sourced. No staffing, fire, access, rental or site-today evidence in the sources read. The Flathead county list at montanalookouts.weebly.com/flathead-county.html gives a township-range code (24N-12W-3) that was not used.
